title.label: Thank you thank you thank you

I slept so peacefully my brother thought I was listening to like something on my iPad like Netflix but when he lifted my headphones, he heard the calming sleep. Sounds so he put the headphones back on and I slept peacefully thank you so much for putting the Endel in the App Store. You well this really helped me. It's almost scary how accurate this app is at telling me where my body is at with my energy!

For decades, I've been waking up at 3:00 AM, and because the rest of the world says it's abnormal, I would make myself try to go back to sleep. Then trying to get up for work was torture! Since I've had this app (which I actually don't use for any other reason than validating how I feel physically), it has validated me so much! I no longer feel like a weirdo for my energy dips and rises.

I don't remember if I answered some questions when I first set up my account or what, but however it works, whenever I feel weird about feeling sleepy, I check it, and how I feel matches what the app predicts about 98% of the time. Call it spooky or call it science. Either way, it is very validating for me!

title.label: Endel continues to soothe and focus my brain

content.label: I found Endel when it first came out, 2017 or so. I struggled with technical issues on my ancient phone but loved when it worked. While off grid in the woods for 2 weeks, this became my soundtrack on my iphone 12 mini, which I still use. At that point endel worked offline, with the most basic sounds free and no 10 minute limit. It was incredible and non-invasive in the natural space. I also used it at night on low volume to warn the cougars and bears of my presence. I didn't die! Yay! I finally purchased a year of it now, in 2026, because I need it more than ever being finally diagnosed with adhd and autism. I love focus, move and sleep-I love the way it supports my odd hours or focus and helps me rest easily for sleep. When I turn it off, I almost feel like I was being physically pushed and then, like the push is gone when I turn it off. It actually supports focus, aligns with neuroplasticity experiments and is simply my fave thing to listen to for all activities! It's expensive and I wish it was more accessible for lower income people. But even the free version is super helpful. LOVE IT!

It was the love at the first sight… And the first  sound…

The highly polished interface, the incredible visuals and soundscapes… All played the role in decision making!

But , the instant responses from the app support ( that some reviewers had  comically classified as “nonexistent” !!!) helped to “seal” the deal! 
Thank you, Arto!!!

To the Developers:
REMARKABLY WELL DONE!
Outstanding! Bravo!!!”
